reviews.text:
The reception staff and nurses were very helpful, and the hospital itself was clean; I think it's a nice hospital overall.

However, the attitude of the female veterinarian who treated my dog ​​was very disappointing.

During the examination, she sighed when my dog ​​didn't cooperate, and she spoke harshly to the nurse holding the dog, saying, "You can't do it, let so-and-so take over." It was very unpleasant to witness. It's natural for dogs to dislike having their eyes touched.

Furthermore, when I asked a question after carefully listening to the explanation during the examination, she responded, "Were you even listening?"

It's not that I hadn't listened; I simply wanted to clarify things I didn't understand about my beloved dog.

As a pet owner, it's natural to ask questions about things I'm worried about or don't understand when seeking specialized care at an animal hospital, especially an ophthalmology clinic. Being spoken to in this manner makes me hesitant to ask questions in the future.

I ended up going to a different ophthalmology clinic, and that hospital never exhibited such behavior.

I had no particular complaints about the reception staff, nurses, or the clinic environment, but the veterinarian's attitude towards the dogs, staff, and owners, among other things, did not make me feel comfortable entrusting my beloved dog to them.

I was taking my dog ​​there for dry eye. Initially, I chose this clinic as my dog's regular ophthalmologist because I thought they had high knowledge and skill.

However, as I continued going, I became bothered by the frequent negative comments (perhaps not malicious?) about supplements and clinics that I relied on. Looking at it that way, I started to notice a condescending attitude towards the staff.

At that point, I felt like they were constantly negating things I believed in, and that negativity towards my beliefs and the clinic felt like a negation of me. I became reluctant to go and switched to another clinic. Now I'm glad I switched.

As other reviews have mentioned, there were some aspects of their behavior that made me question their professionalism, hence this rating.

They may have knowledge, but I've also heard stories from other dog owners about unsuccessful surgeries performed by this vet. When choosing a regular vet, I think it's best to consider all factors carefully before making a decision.

They are kind and thorough, and provide high-level ophthalmic care. They also take pictures of your eyes and explain everything while showing you the images, so you can receive treatment with confidence.

I had an urgent matter come up at the last minute, so I asked if it was possible to change the date and time, even though it was only 30 minutes before my appointment.

For some reason, the receptionist transferred me to the veterinarian, and
I was told that they couldn't change the appointment and that I wouldn't be able to make any future appointments.

I had my dog's eyes checked there the last time, and I thought it was a very reassuring hospital with excellent service, just as the reviews said. This was my second planned visit.

I admit I was partly to blame for the last-minute change, but I got the impression that they were being quite arrogant.

I could understand if it was a case of repeated cancellations and changes, but this was unacceptable.

The veterinarians and staff were incredibly kind, professional, and caring. They treated our pet with great tenderness and took the time to explain everything clearly. The clinic was clean, well-equipped, and extremely organized, which put us at ease from the moment we arrived. We are grateful for this excellent care and highly recommend this clinic to all pet owners.

I visited the clinic for my first consultation yesterday. First of all, I was impressed by the cleanliness of the entire clinic, which showed their love for animals. The doctor's thorough examination and the nurses' attentiveness were also wonderful. In addition, they explained the symptoms and eye drops, even showing me copies of photos of the pathogens. Furthermore, they wrote detailed handwritten explanations, which made it easy to understand even the difficult information. I will continue to bring my dog ​​there, and I would highly recommend this hospital to any dog ​​owners whose dogs are suffering from eye problems.

My beloved dog, who passed away last year, used to come to this clinic once a month from Tohoku for checkups. The doctor provided detailed and easy-to-understand explanations, specialized ophthalmological examinations and treatments, and the hospital in Jiyugaoka that the doctor recommended was also very kind. I feel like I was able to do everything I could for him until the very end. I'll never forget how my dog ​​loved the cookies after his checkups; he would eat them with such enthusiasm, even though he was an old dog! (laughs)

I felt extremely uncomfortable with the doctor's attitude.

He was ill-tempered throughout, and his language was condescending and intimidating. It was far from an environment where I could feel comfortable discussing my concerns.

Furthermore, I felt there was a major problem with how he handled the dog during the examination.

Suddenly reaching out to the dog's face without any consideration is frightening, and the dog was clearly very scared. I couldn't help but feel distrustful because he couldn't even handle basic handling.

In addition, despite the nurses' courteous service, the doctor's attitude towards them was also very unpleasant. I felt it negatively impacted the atmosphere of the clinic.

My cat is prone to watery eyes and has sensitive eyes due to her breed, but this vet offers various tests and treatments, just like they would for a human.

She had severe eye discharge, and when I went to other hospitals, they just dismissed it as unavoidable due to her breed and didn't provide sufficient tests or treatment. That's when I found this hospital and started going there, and I'm so glad I did.

Her condition has improved compared to the beginning, the treatment is working, and my anxiety and worries have been greatly reduced. I think I'll continue to use their services in the future.

I highly recommend this hospital to anyone with eye problems.

My 13-year-old dog's eyes have started to turn cloudy, so I was worried and decided to take him to an ophthalmologist.
First of all, both the staff and the doctor were incredibly kind and helpful. Thank you very much! 😊
The doctor's explanation after the examination was very thorough and easy to understand, and I felt that they truly understood the feelings of a worried pet owner.
I have a regular veterinary clinic I take my dog ​​to, but I'm glad I had him examined by an ophthalmologist this time.

I visited this clinic after being referred by my regular vet. The doctor and nurses were very kind and attentive. They even carefully packaged the medication, and used the same equipment as for human eyes, which was very reassuring. I had never considered looking for an ophthalmologist for my dog, but thanks to the referral, I found a great clinic.
I'm also grateful to the doctors at my regular vet.
It's close to the station and easy to find, so I'll definitely consult them again if anything comes up in the future.
Very thorough, helpful in explaining diagnosis. They translated their findings for me as well.

I went there for a long time because of tear stains, which I had been struggling with and trying various treatments for.

Relatedly, they were able to diagnose a disease that other hospitals hadn't been able to identify, and they performed various tests to give my dog ​​a thorough examination. I also felt that the doctors and nurses were trustworthy and handled my dog ​​in a way that calmed him down. If you're worried about your dog's eyes, I recommend you give them a try.

A hospital with the worst patient service
The veterinarian was extremely condescending and arrogant.

My dog's condition suddenly worsened, so I inquired about the possibility of an earlier appointment. The veterinarian lectured me rudely, telling me to book an earlier appointment from the start.
Shouldn't they prioritize my dog's well-being? I doubt they have any compassion for animals as a veterinarian.

Furthermore, they said that a same-day visit would mean waiting over four hours between appointments. When I asked if this would compromise the quality of the examination, they told me, "That's rude." They were the one being rude from the beginning, speaking rudely.

They were a bundle of pride, completely lacking any consideration for the patient. I had been patient for a while after the initial lecture, but at this point I snapped and said, "I don't know your situation or circumstances," to which they responded by saying I didn't need to come.

In a hospital that deals with lives, prioritizing one's own pride—I don't know how amazing your skills are, but you should first reconsider your professional ethics.

Addendum 1: They even contacted me to delete the review… Seeing how sensitively you react to a single review reveals your true capabilities.

I received excellent care for my glaucoma.

It was a sudden illness, but they were able to come in immediately, which was a great help.

At subsequent regular checkups, the doctor and staff were very kind, and my child seems to enjoy coming to the clinic.

I'm so glad I found such a great ophthalmologist!
If your dog has eye problems, I highly recommend this clinic! The staff is super friendly and you can tell they really love animals!

In the evening, my cat suddenly started having difficulty opening its eyes, and they were watery and had discharge, so I contacted the hospital and decided to come over right away.
However, due to Christmas, traffic was busy and it was difficult to find a taxi. There were also several traffic jams on the way from my house to the hospital, and as expected, I was stuck in one, so I arrived past the appointment time.
However, even in that situation, the nurses were very kind and polite.
The doctor also performed a thorough examination and explained the diagnosis and treatment plan in detail and in an easy-to-understand manner.
In order to understand the condition of animals, which is different from that of humans, I believe it is essential to examine and analyze them from various angles, so the doctor's examination and diagnosis were very reliable.

To be honest, I was a little worried about having to wait overnight and then come back the next day.
My cat's sudden change had me hectic and panicking, but even though it was my first appointment, you were so kind and accommodated me even though I had to come after office hours, and I'm grateful for your thorough examination.

Thanks to you, my cat was healthy and acting as usual when I returned home, and I now know what I need to do from now on.
I can now care for my cat with peace of mind.
Thank you so much.
